Black box Connect to saved wheels and record automatically, without opening the app. Recording starts as soon as a wheel connects. On Android 12+, associate each saved wheel once: TuxWheel disconnects during association because a connected wheel cannot be found, then Android watches the wheel, even after a phone restart. Force-stop, revoked permissions or vendor battery restrictions can stop the mode. On Android 6–11, waiting needs a permanent notification plus location permission; Android 10–11 also require background location.
